highlights.title: Bovespa cai após acionar 'circuit braker', e dólar dispara após vitória de Lula; siga
highlights.summary: Com 100% dos votos apurados, petista venceu disputa contra Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) por 4,4 milhões de votos; acompanhe a cobertura completa.

highlights.title: Serbia’s Election Shows New Vulnerability for Nationalist Populists
highlights.summary: In much of Europe, the advance of the right has been seen as unstoppable. But in the east, nationalists are being cast aside in places where they long governed.

highlights.title: UN cites 'ethnic cleansing' concerns around Israel's Palestinian displacement operation in Hebron
highlights.summary: The United Nations on Monday raised "ethnic cleansing" concerns following Israel's operation to displace by force more than 3,000 Palestinians from their homes in Hebron in the West Bank after two Palestinian gunmen killed two Israeli soldiers at a checkpoint near the city on Friday.
